meta.deviceTitle: Sign in the command line · Workstream

device.signInNote: The Workstream command line on your computer asked to sign in. Sign in here first, then you can allow it.
device.approveTitle: Allow the command line to act as you?
device.approveBody: The Workstream command line on your computer will be signed in as {email}. It can see your teams and their tasks, and start tasks. It can't change, stop or delete anything, and it can't open a desktop.
device.codeLabel: Check that your terminal shows this code:
device.approvedTitle: The command line is signed in
device.approvedBody: Go back to your terminal. You can close this tab.
device.deniedTitle: The command line was not signed in
device.deniedBody: Nothing changed on your account. You can close this tab.
device.unusableTitle: This sign-in link can't be used
device.unusable: It may have expired or been used already. Run workstream login again to get a new one.

signIn.title: Sign in to Workstream
signIn.subtitleCode: We'll email you a code. No password to remember.
signIn.subtitlePassword: Sign in with your email and password.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: You get a team of your own, and a desktop for your first task.
signUp.switch: Already have an account? Sign in

verify.title: Enter the code
verify.subtitle: We sent a six-digit code to {email}.

name.title: What should we call you?
name.subtitle: That email is new here. Add your name to finish creating your account.

errors.failed: Sign-in did not work. Try again.
errors.provider: Signing in with GitHub did not work. Try again, or sign in with your email.

invite.title: Join {team}
invite.subtitleNew: Create your account and you're on {team}.
invite.subtitleCode: We'll email you a code, then you're on the team.
invite.subtitlePassword: Sign in and you're on the team.
invite.emailHint: The invitation was sent to this address.
invite.unusable: It may have expired, been withdrawn, or been used already. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
